concept.hr: Prag, brojač na emulatoru PDC-a i zastarjela lozinka koja zaključa račun
concept.en: Threshold, bad-password count at the PDC emulator, a stale password locking it

summary.hr: Krive lozinke s dva računala i mobitel sa starom lozinkom: svaki DC broji za sebe, PDC broji sve, a prag zaključava račun na svim DC-ovima.
summary.en: Wrong passwords from two PCs and a phone with an old one: each DC counts its own, the PDC counts them all, and the threshold locks the account everywhere.
